findings.observation: The broad oval outline, asymmetric brow treatment, broad cheeks, upturned nose, heavy lower lip, brow notch, and calm mouth remain related to Valel, but the summon-v2's rich very-deep ebony-brown band-6 skin is lightened to medium-deep and the eyes and facial planes shift toward a younger generic doll treatment rather than an unmistakable mature 29-year-old identity.

Upper arms and forearms remain natural, wrists stay defined, and both empty hands have coherent fingers and proportional girth without generic chibi inflation.
The brown-chestnut hair preserves the source swept loose mass, side braids and shaved detail, and metallic wrapped section without a new color or silhouette family.

The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored tunic, divided trousers, offset closures, narrow cuffs, restrained edge colors, and mismatched contrasting boot laces remain source-faithful, but the polished seed case held in the summon is omitted, breaking accessory continuity.
Visual measurement places the complete head-and-hair unit at approximately 32-33% of standing figure height, inside the required 32-36% window and about 3.05 heads tall.
Exactly one complete subject appears; full hair, head, both hands, layered hems, both boots, laces, and grounding shadow remain inside generous safe margins with no crop or duplicate anatomy.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, compact silhouette, separated hands and boots, mantle, and restrained color blocking read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.
The image remains ordinary mortal cloth and travel footwear with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
